# Tiferes — Exact First-Wave File Map

## New Modules Preferred
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/platform/productRouteManifest.js` — explicit non-first-level/nested commerce routes and aliases.
- `shared/commerce/catalogIdentity.js` — resolve explicit card identity without brittle URL-only inference.
- `shared/commerce/catalogSummary.js` — pure live SKU summarization for supporter and credit-pack merchandising.
- `shared/commerce/catalogBoot.js` — route-aware, lazy catalog badge boot.
- `api/wallet/tests/catalogCommerceIdentity.test.js` — prove the catalog and commerce graph agree.

## Existing Files Eligible For Whole Rewrite After Full Read
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/platform/productDiscovery.js`
- `shared/commerce/catalogBadges.js`
- `scripts/awtsmoos/ui/foundation.js`
- `games/scripts/catalog/markup/MalchusGameCardMarkup.mjs`
- `api/wallet/tests/platformCommerceCoverage.test.js`

## Explicitly Avoid For First Wave
- Dirty app catalog renderer unless unavoidable.
- Dirty Tetris files; global foundation is the intended commerce boot.
- Dirty wallet purchase engine unless a test proves an actual defect.
